```{r}
library(cliomicplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
```

## Overview

The volcano plot is the standard visualisation for genome-wide differential expression experiments, plotting statistical significance ($-\log_{10} P_{\text{adj}}$) against effect size ($\log_2\text{FC}$).

This vignette demonstrates publication-ready volcano plotting using human skin RNA-seq data from NCBI GEO accession **GSE121212** (Atopic Dermatitis vs. Healthy Control skin biopsies). All figures use the `type_volcano()` constructor within `cliplot()`, illustrating default cutoffs, curated gene signatures, and rich annotation call-outs.

---

## 1. Real GEO Dataset: GSE121212 (Atopic Dermatitis vs. Healthy Skin)

The dataset comes from NCBI GEO accession **GSE121212**:

- **Cohort**: Full-thickness skin biopsies from patients with active Atopic Dermatitis ($N = 27$) and healthy control individuals ($N = 28$).
- **Platform**: Illumina HiSeq 2500 high-throughput RNA sequencing.
- **Differential Expression**: DESeq2 negative binomial generalized linear model with Wald significance testing and Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (`padj`) control.
- **Gene Coverage**: 20,140 tested genes with `baseMean`, `log2FC`, `lfcSE`, `stat`, `pvalue`, and `padj`.

```{r data-load}
# Helper to resolve bundled dataset
resolve_data = function(filename) {
  pkg_path = system.file("extdata", filename, package = "cliomicplot")
  if (pkg_path != "" && file.exists(pkg_path)) return(pkg_path)
  fallback = file.path("..", "inst", "extdata", filename)
  if (file.exists(fallback)) return(fallback)
  fallback2 = file.path("inst", "extdata", filename)
  if (file.exists(fallback2)) return(fallback2)
  stop("Cannot locate ", filename)
}

de_results = readRDS(resolve_data("geo_gse121212_de.rds"))

# Inspect top differentially expressed genes
head(de_results[, c("gene", "baseMean", "log2FC", "lfcSE", "pvalue", "padj")])
```

Across the 20,140 tested genes, 1,189 meet stringent significance criteria ($P_{\text{adj}} < 0.05$ and $|\log_2\text{FC}| > 1.5$), with 812 genes upregulated and 377 downregulated in atopic skin.

---

## 2. Quick Volcano Plot: One Call

`cliplot()` accepts the standard formula `y ~ x`, where the y-axis specifies significance ($-\log_{10} P_{\text{adj}}$) and the x-axis specifies effect size ($\log_2\text{FC}$):

```{r fig1-quick-volcano}
cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = de_results,
        type  = type_volcano(
          pval_cutoff  = 0.01,
          fc_cutoff    = 1.5,
          point_size   = 1.8,
          point_alpha  = 0.60,
          label_genes  = c("SERPINB4", "CCL18", "S100A7", "LCE3A", "SPRR2G",
                           "ALOX15", "GPLD1", "IL20RA", "SPTLC3"),
          max_overlaps = 25
        ),
        palette = "nature",
        theme   = "nature",
        title   = "**Figure 1** — NCBI GEO GSE121212: Atopic Dermatitis vs. Control",
        subtitle = "Bulk RNA-seq | FDR < 0.01, |log₂FC| > 1.50") +
  cli_markdown()
```

This single command coordinates:
- Classification into **Up** (red), **Down** (blue), and **NS** (grey).
- Threshold reference lines at $P_{\text{adj}} = 0.01$ and $\log_2\text{FC} = \pm 1.5$.
- Automatic `ggrepel` label positioning with collision avoidance.
- Nature-style open axes without top and right spines.

### Biological Findings in GSE121212

- **Epidermal Differentiation Complex (EDC)**: Strongly upregulated genes include *LCE3A* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +7.25$, $P_{\text{adj}} = 2.93 \times 10^{-38}$), *LCE3D* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +5.09$), *SPRR2G* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +4.42$), and *S100A7* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +5.35$, psoriasin).
- **Th2 Immune Activation**: *SERPINB4* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +6.45$, squamous cell carcinoma antigen 2) and *CCL18* ($\log_2\text{FC} = +4.59$, dendritic cell-derived chemokine).
- **Downregulated Barrier Components**: *SPTLC3* ($\log_2\text{FC} = -0.57$, serine palmitoyltransferase required for ceramide synthesis) and *GPLD1* ($\log_2\text{FC} = -0.90$, glycosylphosphatidylinositol-specific phospholipase D1).

---

## 3. Customising Parameters & Curated Disease Signatures

`type_volcano()` provides complete control over thresholds, colors, point transparency, and background shading:

```{r fig2-custom-volcano}
# Curated Th2 inflammatory and barrier signature
signature_genes = c("CCL18", "SERPINB4", "S100A7", "S100A8", "S100A9",
                    "LCE3A", "LCE3D", "ALOX15", "IL20RA", "SPTLC3", "GPLD1")

cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = de_results,
        type = type_volcano(
          pval_cutoff    = 0.001,
          fc_cutoff      = 2.0,
          point_size     = 1.7,
          point_alpha    = 0.65,
          up_color       = "#D73027",
          down_color     = "#2B6CB0",
          ns_color       = "#D0D4DC",
          label_genes    = signature_genes,
          max_overlaps   = 30,
          cutoff_region_alpha = 0.05,
          show_threshold_labels = TRUE
        ),
        theme   = "cell",
        title   = "**Figure 2** — High-Stringency Volcano with Curated Signature",
        subtitle = "Cell Press Style | FDR < 0.001, |log₂FC| > 2.0") +
  cli_markdown() +
  cli_panel_label("a")
```

Setting `label_genes` to an explicit character vector restricts labeling to hypotheses of interest, avoiding overcrowded text in dense datasets.

---

## 4. Biomarker Annotation Call-Out Box

Manuscript figures frequently highlight one or two lead candidate biomarkers with an annotation card reporting exact effect sizes, confidence intervals, and multiple-testing adjusted statistics.

Here, we annotate *CCL18*, a validated serum and tissue biomarker of atopic dermatitis severity:

```{r fig3-callout-volcano}
# Extract statistics for CCL18
highlight = de_results["CCL18", ]
highlight$ci_low  = round(highlight$log2FC - 1.96 * highlight$lfcSE, 2)
highlight$ci_high = round(highlight$log2FC + 1.96 * highlight$lfcSE, 2)
highlight$fold_change = round(2^highlight$log2FC, 1)

highlight$annot = paste0(
  "<b><i>", highlight$gene, "</i></b><br>",
  "<b>log₂FC = +", round(highlight$log2FC, 2), "</b> (", highlight$fold_change, "× fold increase)<br>",
  "95% CI: [", highlight$ci_low, ", ", highlight$ci_high, "]<br>",
  "<b>FDR = 4.04 × 10<sup>-32</sup></b><br>",
  "<span style='font-size:8pt;color:#555;'>Th2 Chemokine / CCR8+ T-cell recruiter</span>"
)

# Base volcano plot
p_base = cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = de_results,
  type = type_volcano(
    pval_cutoff  = 0.01,
    fc_cutoff    = 1.5,
    point_size   = 1.8,
    point_alpha  = 0.55,
    label_genes  = c("SERPINB4", "S100A7", "LCE3A", "ALOX15", "GPLD1", "SPTLC3"),
    max_overlaps = 20
  ),
  palette = "nature", theme = "nature",
  title   = "**Figure 3** — Volcano Plot with *CCL18* Biomarker Call-Out",
  subtitle = "NCBI GEO GSE121212 | Human Skin Biopsies") +
  cli_markdown()

# Layer call-out box and leader segment
p_annot = p_base +
  geom_point(
    data = highlight,
    aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(padj)),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 21, size = 4.5, stroke = 1.3,
    fill = "#C95C43", colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_richtext(
    data = highlight,
    aes(x = log2FC - 4.2, y = -log10(padj) + 5, label = annot),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0, vjust = 0.5,
    size = 3.2, fill = "#FDF2E9", colour = "black",
    label.colour = "#C95C43", label.padding = grid::unit(c(6, 8, 6, 8), "pt")
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = highlight,
    aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(padj),
        xend = log2FC - 1.2, yend = -log10(padj) + 3),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#555555"
  )

p_annot
```

---

## 5. Using External GEO and DESeq2 Results

To apply `type_volcano()` to other NCBI GEO datasets or custom differential expression pipelines (DESeq2, edgeR, limma):

1. **Required Columns**: Ensure your data frame contains a log2 fold change column (`log2FC`) and an adjusted significance column (`padj`).
2. **Gene Symbols**: Assign gene symbols to `rownames(df)` or a `gene` column.
3. **P-Value Floor**: Cap extreme floating-point zeros to prevent infinite values on the $-\log_{10}$ scale:

```r
# Typical loading script for external GEO data
# res = read.csv("GSEXXXXX_differential_expression.csv", row.names = 1)
# res$padj = pmax(res$padj, 1e-300)

# cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ log2FC, data = res,
#         type = type_volcano(pval_cutoff = 0.05, fc_cutoff = 1.0),
#         theme = "nature")
```

---

## 6. Journal Export & Physical Trim Dimensions

`cli_journal_size()` returns publisher print dimensions in millimeters. Figures can be exported directly to target column widths using `cli_save()`:

```{r eval = FALSE}
# Check Nature single-column width (89 mm)
cli_journal_size("nature", "single")

# Save as vector PDF conforming to Nature single-column width
cli_save(p_annot, "Figure_3_GSE121212.pdf", journal = "nature", column = "single")

# Save double-column layout for multi-panel assembly
cli_save(p_annot, "Figure_3_GSE121212_double.svg", journal = "cell", column = "double")
```

---

## Summary

| Parameter / Feature | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `pval_cutoff` | Significance cutoff on adjusted p-value | `0.05` |
| `fc_cutoff` | Absolute $\log_2\text{FC}$ threshold | `1.0` (2-fold) |
| `label_genes` | Vector of gene symbols, `"significant"`, or `NULL` | `NULL` |
| `max_overlaps` | Maximum overlapping labels before hiding (`ggrepel`) | `25` |
| `cutoff_region_alpha` | Transparency of shaded significance quadrant rectangles | `0.045` |
| `up_color` / `down_color` | Hex codes for directional significance classes | `#D73027` / `#2B6CB0` |
| `ns_color` | Color for non-significant genes | `#A8B0BA` |
